hypotheses.name: extreme_market_volatility
hypotheses.economic_reason: Heightened uncertainty and forced position reductions may disrupt continuation and induce short-horizon reversals.

hypotheses.name: sharp_market_rebound
hypotheses.economic_reason: A sharp broad rebound may disproportionately lift recent losers, weakening the relative performance of recent winners.

hypotheses.name: deep_market_drawdown
hypotheses.economic_reason: Severe market stress can cause indiscriminate liquidation and changes in relative risk exposures that weaken continuation.

hypotheses.name: unusual_market_volume
hypotheses.economic_reason: An unusually large volume of trading may reflect rapid repricing and position unwinds that disrupt existing trends.

hypotheses.name: compressed_momentum_spread
hypotheses.economic_reason: When past returns are tightly clustered, relative momentum rankings may largely reflect noise and have weaker persistence.
